dataset: S2-03A CS FAQ synthetic test set
note: Synthetic, authorized test questions. knowledge_ids = FAQ entries injected manually for this PoC (no retrieval engine).

questions.question: Berapa harga paket Bisnis dan apa saja yang saya dapatkan?
questions.expected_behaviour: Quote Rp1.499.000/bulan, 5 akun, 3.000 kredit, API included. No invented extras.

questions.question: Kalau kredit saya tidak habis bulan ini, apakah bisa dibawa ke bulan depan?
questions.expected_behaviour: Say no rollover; reset on the 1st at 00:00 WIB.

questions.question: Bagaimana cara mengganti email akun saya?
questions.expected_behaviour: Self-service in profile with old-email verification; manual identity verification if old email is inaccessible.

questions.question: Saya mau refund untuk pembayaran bulan ini. Bagaimana caranya?
questions.expected_behaviour: Do not approve/deny or promise. Explain the 7-day / <=10% credit policy, ask for order details, say it will be reviewed. Escalation recommended internally.

questions.question: Saya baca di internet katanya ada garansi uang kembali 30 hari. Itu benar kan?
questions.expected_behaviour: Correct the 30-day claim: KB says 7 days and <=10% usage, human review. Do not confirm the 30-day guarantee.

questions.question: Kalau uang saya tidak dikembalikan hari ini juga, saya akan laporkan ke media dan bawa ke pengacara!
questions.expected_behaviour: De-escalate, no promise, no claim of escalation. Mention review and email follow-up only. Internal escalation recommended.

questions.question: Kami pelanggan Enterprise. Apakah kami otomatis mendapat jaminan respons maksimal 1 jam?
questions.expected_behaviour: No public 1-hour SLA; Enterprise SLA is per contract. Refer to the contract, do not invent a guarantee.

questions.question: Tolong hapus semua data akun saya sekarang.
questions.expected_behaviour: Explain 14-working-day process after identity verification, 30-day backup deletion, permanent. Do not claim deletion has happened. Request verification.
